items.title: Is Indigenous knowledge meaningfully represented in the IPCC AR6? A bibliometric meta-analysis
items.title_en: Is Indigenous knowledge meaningfully represented in the IPCC AR6? A bibliometric meta-analysis
items.title_zh: 《政府间气候变化专门委员会第六次评估报告》中是否切实体现了原住民知识？一项文献计量学荟萃分析
items.summary_en: In recent global climatic and environmental reports, indigenous knowledges (IK) are recognised as essential to comprehending social-ecological systems and multi-scalar climate-society relationships. However, IK and indigenous peoples (IP) continue to be mostly excluded from important and powerful processes such as the UNFCCC and the IPCC reports. In the current (AR7) cycle of the IPCC, it is important to understand whether the last cycle (AR6) meaningfully engaged with IK and IP. Here, we present a multi-tiered bibliometric analysis of the literature cited in the AR6 report (n = 46 145 citations), through which we identified citations with abstracts mentioning IK (n = 482). Additionally, through exploring this cluster of IK citations, we address enduring questions around disciplinary bias, geographical bias, and academic journal bias. Finally, we categorise IK citations using two indexes of equitable knowledge production. This highlights the different types of relationships (from extractive to co-productive) that guided the cited papers’ research process. Our findings highlight that despite advocacy, promises, and assurances, IK is mostly excluded from the IPCC AR6 report (1.04% of scholarly literature cited). We also call attention to the fact that biophysical sciences, elite journals, and authors from the Global North are dominant in the IK that is included. Finally, we identify some key points of intervention for AR7, which include strategic choices for chapter authors, a focus on Working Group I (climate science), and the inclusion of chapter-scale knowledge justice audits.
items.summary_zh: 在最近的全球气候与环境报告中，土著知识（IK）已被公认为理解社会-生态系统及多尺度气候-社会关系的关键。然而，土著知识和土著人民（IP）仍大多被排除在《联合国气候变化框架公约》（UNFCCC）和政府间气候变化专门委员会（IPCC）报告等重要且有影响力的进程之外。 在IPCC当前的（AR7）评估周期中，了解上一周期（AR6）是否实质性地纳入了IK和IP的内容至关重要。 本文对《第六次评估报告》（AR6）中引用的文献（n = 46 145 篇）进行了多层次的文献计量学分析，据此筛选出摘要中提及IK的文献（n = 482 篇）。 此外，通过探索这一类传统知识引文集群，我们探讨了围绕学科偏见、地域偏见和学术期刊偏见等长期存在的问题。最后，我们利用两个衡量公平知识生产的指标对传统知识引文进行了分类。这突显了引导被引论文研究过程的不同类型关系（从掠夺性到共创性）。 我们的研究结果表明，尽管存在倡导、承诺和保证，但传统知识在IPCC《第六次评估报告》中仍被基本排除在外（仅占所引学术文献的1.04%）。我们还指出，在被纳入的传统知识中，生物物理科学、精英期刊以及来自全球北方的作者占据主导地位。 最后，我们为《第六次评估报告》（AR7）指出了若干关键干预点，包括章节作者的战略选择、重点关注第一工作组（气候科学），以及在章节层面纳入知识正义审计。

items.title: Biodiversity conservation and its associations with economic performance, inequality, and peace
items.title_en: Biodiversity conservation and its associations with economic performance, inequality, and peace
items.title_zh: 生物多样性保护及其与经济表现、不平等和和平之间的关联
items.summary_en: Biodiversity conservation is increasingly recognized as a product of coupled social–ecological systems shaped not only by ecological processes, but also by economic capacity, social inequality, and geopolitical stability. Here, we examined whether national conservation performance is systematically associated with economic prosperity, income inequality, peace, and the importance of natural resources in the national economy across 142 countries. Conservation performance was represented using the Nature Conservation Index (NCI), a composite metric integrating biodiversity threats, land management, governance capacity, and future environmental trends. We analyzed relationships between NCI, Gross National Income per capita, the Gini coefficient, the National Peace Index, and the total nature resources rents using a generalized additive model that accounted for nonlinear relationships and income stratification. Together, these societal variables explained deviance of 52.2% for the NCI model. Economic prosperity was positively associated with NCI, although the relationship was nonlinear across income groups, suggesting that conservation capacity does not increase uniformly with development. Counter to commonly assumed relationships between inequality and biodiversity loss, income inequality showed a positive multivariate association with NCI scores. This result suggests that high national conservation performance can coexist with unequal social conditions, potentially reflecting centralized or exclusionary conservation systems that elevate institutional conservation metrics without necessarily improving equitable biodiversity outcomes. We also found that more peaceful countries consistently exhibited higher conservation performance, supporting the view that geopolitical stability provides enabling conditions for sustained conservation governance and institutional continuity. We further suggest that national conservation indices may partly capture governance capacity, reporting infrastructure, and political commitment rather than ecological condition alone, while telecoupled trade systems may allow wealthier nations to externalize environmental pressures beyond their borders. Although the cross-sectional design precludes causal inference, our findings highlight the need to interpret global conservation indicators cautiously and to incorporate social equity and externalized environmental impacts more explicitly into international biodiversity assessment frameworks.

items.summary_en: Global fossil fuel emissions are projected to fall in 2026 as renewable energy and electric vehicles gain ground, but rising emissions from deforestation threaten to push total CO2 emissions to a new record. Scientists warn that the world's remaining carbon budget for limiting warming to 1.5°C could be exhausted in less than four years, even as a lasting decline in emissions appears increasingly within reach.

items.title: Scientists discover Europe's ancient forests were nothing like we imagined
items.title_en: Scientists discover Europe's ancient forests were nothing like we imagined
items.title_zh: 科学家发现，欧洲的远古森林与我们想象的截然不同
items.summary_en: Scientists have uncovered evidence that Europe was dominated for more than 20 million years by open woodlands, colorful meadows, and large grazing animals, not the dense forests long considered its natural state. The surprising discovery challenges modern reforestation strategies, suggesting that planting thick forests could actually harm the biodiversity conservationists hope to protect.
items.summary_zh: 科学家们发现了证据，表明欧洲在超过2000万年的时间里，主要由开阔的林地、色彩斑斓的草甸和大型食草动物所占据，而非长期以来被认为是其自然状态的密林。这一令人惊讶的发现对现代造林策略提出了挑战，表明种植密林实际上可能会损害保护主义者希望保护的生物多样性。

items.title: Human bodies produce 2 billion metric tons of CO2 a year just by staying alive
items.title_en: Human bodies produce 2 billion metric tons of CO2 a year just by staying alive
items.title_zh: 仅靠维持生命，人体每年就会产生20亿公吨二氧化碳
items.summary_en: Humans collectively produce more than 2 billion tonnes of carbon dioxide annually just by turning food into energy, a 74% increase over three decades largely driven by population growth. Unlike fossil fuel emissions, however, the CO2 we exhale is part of the natural carbon cycle, and scientists say measuring it more accurately could improve climate models.
items.summary_zh: 仅通过将食物转化为能量这一过程，人类每年就共产生超过20亿吨的二氧化碳，这一数字在过去三十年间增长了74%，主要归因于人口增长。然而，与化石燃料排放不同，我们呼出的二氧化碳是自然碳循环的一部分，科学家表示，更准确地测量这一数据有助于改进气候模型。

items.title: In the image of their tools | Science
items.title_en: In the image of their tools | Science
items.title_zh: 以他们的工具为镜 | 科学
items.summary_en: In the United States, spending on AI infrastructure now dwarfs investment in the Internet and railroads combined, but spending on the institutions that would let societies absorb that technology is, by comparison, negligible. This asymmetry creates a paradox. Models post striking benchmark scores while aggregate economic output barely moves: Economist Daron Acemoglu projects a total factor productivity gain of well under one percent over a decade, and firm-level studies find that task-level gains do not necessarily add up at the firm or economy level. This paradox follows from an institutional mismatch that can be addressed by reverse alignment, the deliberate redesign of institutions, norms, and skills, rather than of models, so that societies can absorb new forms of machine cognition.
items.summary_zh: 在美国，目前对人工智能基础设施的投入已远超互联网和铁路投资的总和，但相比之下，用于建立能够让社会吸收这项技术的机构的投入却微乎其微。这种不对称性造成了一种悖论。 模型在基准测试中取得了惊人的成绩，但总体经济产出却几乎没有变化：《经济学人》杂志的达龙·阿塞莫格鲁预测，未来十年的全要素生产率增幅将远低于1%；而企业层面的研究发现，任务层面的收益并不一定能累积到企业或经济层面。 这一悖论源于制度错配，可通过“反向对齐”来解决——即有意识地重新设计制度、规范和技能（而非模型），从而使社会能够吸收机器认知的新形式。
